lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy3Ag crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing four atoms (Dy3Ag) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ag and Dy centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Ag is surrounded by 12 Dy neighbors, while Dy has 4 Ag and 8 Dy neighbors, all at 3.4142 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal Dy–Dy 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face relations, while Ag–Dy polyhedra share edges.
